Emily (Partnerships): Flux Labs (LangChain) wants a joint listing + SSO via our gateway. They asked for a compatibility badge, short integration guide, and a PR embargo. Can we scope?
Samir (Platform Eng): Quick: do we standardize on OIDC metadata + redirect allowlist for marketplace vs private?
Grace (Integrations): Yes. Minimal checklist: OIDC issuer, redirect URIs, token introspection endpoint, optional SCIM. Also provide adapter manifest for auto-detect.
Olivia (Solutions): We should give a perf target for their sample LangChain agent. Ask: peak concurrency and seq lengths.
Emily (Partnerships): Flux expects demo spikes ~200 rps, short seqs.
Marco (Marketplace): Marketplace intake needs one-pager, trial plan, logo, privacy blurb, and billing contact. Align embargo before submission.
Samir (Platform Eng): We'll produce adapter scaffold with two auth modes (auth-proxy, delegated) and add usage headers for metering.
Grace (Integrations): Ill draft SSO checklist + a manifest snippet and drop links here.
Olivia (Solutions): Ill own README + example prompts and the usage header spec.
Emily (Partnerships): Action: Emily = legal contact + embargo; Grace = SSO + manifest; Samir/Olivia = adapter + README; Marco = intake once assets ready. Tagging @partner-bot to create a partner ticket.
partner-bot: created FLUX-2026-02 and scheduled follow-up for 2026-03-05.
Emily (Partnerships): Reconvene next Thu 10am PT. Thanks all. :tada:
